# Balkrishna Boys' PG

> Official website for Balkrishna Boys' PG, a furnished paying guest accommodation for male students and working professionals near Sola Railway Crossing and Science City Road, Ghatlodiya, Ahmedabad, managed by owner Kashyap Patel.

Monthly rent includes 3 daily 100% pure vegetarian meals (morning self-pack lunch tiffin, Gujarati/North Indian menus, Jain food on request; Sunday dinner off), commercial fiber Wi-Fi, automatic washing machines, daily housekeeping, chilled RO drinking water, hot water geysers, furnishings (bed, mattress, pillow, bedsheet, lockable wardrobe, study desk/chair), and regular electricity. For AC rooms, AC power is billed separately per digital sub-meter at government tariff rates. Online payments and instant bed booking are not supported on the website; availability checks and visits are handled via phone, WhatsApp, or the inquiry form.

## Rooms & Monthly Rent (Per Person, INR)

- 2 Sharing (Non-AC Only): ₹10,000/month; general/common floor washroom.
- 3 Sharing (Non-AC): ₹8,000/month; general washroom.
- 3 Sharing (AC): ₹9,000/month + AC sub-meter electricity extra; attached bathroom.
- 4 Sharing (Non-AC): ₹8,000/month; general washroom.
- 4 Sharing (AC): ₹9,000/month + AC sub-meter electricity extra; attached bathroom.
- 5 Sharing (Non-AC Only): ₹8,000/month; 1 exclusive room on property, general washroom.

## House Rules & Move-In Terms

- Gate Access: 24/7 open gate with no night curfew.
- Parent Visits: Daily 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM; overnight stay for male parents can be arranged with prior notice.
- Substances & Quiet Hours: Zero smoking, alcohol, or tobacco/gutkha permitted; noise-free study hours after 11:00 PM.
- Deposit, Notice & Payments: 1-month refundable security deposit; 30-day prior vacate notice; Cash, UPI, and Bank Transfer accepted (INR).
